To enable auto mode for this project, you have a few options:

**Option 1: Using `/config` command** (simplest)
```
/config
```
Then select `permissions.defaultMode` and set it to `"auto"`. This writes to `.claude/settings.json` in your project.

**Option 2: Edit settings directly**
Read the existing settings file, then add or update:
```json
{
  "permissions": {
    "defaultMode": "auto"
  }
}
```

**Important notes:**
- Auto mode will classify operations as safe/unsafe and execute safe ones without prompting. Destructive actions (like force-push, destructive deletes) still require confirmation even in auto mode.
- You can customize which operations are blocked/allowed by editing the `autoMode` settings (allow rules, soft_deny, hard_deny sections).
- Auto mode is reversible — you can always switch back to "default" (manual mode) via `/config` or by editing the setting.
- Your first time enabling it, you'll see a dialog confirming you understand the mode's behavior.

{"body":"## Summary

Fixes #772. Documents/attachments with very long, space-less file names made the member sheet scroll horizontally and the layout look broken, instead of truncating with an ellipsis.

## Root cause

The file-name renders already use `truncate`, but `truncate` can only cap an element's width when **every flex ancestor up the chain can shrink** (`min-w-0`). The one missing link was the shared `ItemContent` primitive (`frontend/src/components/ui/item.tsx`):

- `Item` is a flex row (`itemVariants` = `flex items-center …`).
- `ItemContent` is its `flex-1` child but had **no `min-w-0`**, so its min-content floor became the longest unbreakable file name, pushing the entire Records-tab column wider than the sheet's scroll container.

`ContentCard` (stories/events) and the `DocumentFileList` buttons already had `min-w-0` correctly — `ItemContent` was the only gap, and it's shared by the documents, stories, and events sections.

## Changes

- **`frontend/src/components/ui/item.tsx`** — add `min-w-0` to `ItemContent` so its existing truncate chain can take effect. This is the root-cause fix and covers documents, stories, and events (all render inside `Item`/`ItemContent`).
- **`frontend/src/components/shared/member-sheet/DocumentFiles.tsx`** — mirror the link row's `min-w-0` on the file row in `DocumentFileList`, so the component truncates correctly on its own regardless of parent context.
- **`frontend/src/components/shared/member-sheet/MemberSheet.tsx`** — widen the member sheet from `sm:w-135` (540px) to `sm:w-160` (640px) to give the Records tab more room (the optional ask in the issue). `max-w-full` keeps it responsive on small screens.
- **`CHANGELOG.md`** — `Fixed` entry under `## [Unreleased]`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] A document with a very long, space-less file name truncates and does not introduce horizontal scrolling anywhere in the sheet
- [x] Full name remains discoverable via `title` tooltip (already present on the rows)
- [x] Member sheet width reviewed/increased

## Feature-flag decision

Not applicable — this is a layout bug fix to existing UI, not a new user-facing feature.

## Testing

- `npm run build` (tsc + vite) — pass
- `npx vitest run` — 631 passed
- `npm run check-i18n` — pass (no new strings)

CSS-only change; no backend or schema impact. A quick manual check with a very long, space-less attachment name in the Records tab is recommended.
